construct.claim: An exact symbolic width-three H_(n,s) has a uniform explicit constructor polynomial in L+2^s with unique gate extension; it encodes the actual universal stage failure.
construct.scope: Same U, selector encoding, built-ins, program descriptions and exact stage clocks; symbolic counterexample predicate for arbitrary n,s.
construct.derivation: Per-cell symbol and head/state event circuits, absorbing halt, terminal output verification, exact built-ins and weighted clocks; definitional CNF.
unresolved_steps: Prove actual H satisfiability at arbitrarily large n for integer k>=3.
candidate_tests: Compare symbolic program outputs to concrete interpreter; check all bounded-stage CNF base assignments.

alternative.claim: For fixed k the exact failure language B_k is either empty (implying P=NP) or NP-complete; finite B_k implies P=NP.
alternative.scope: Same stage on explicit valid selectors; fixed exponent and nonuniform constant bad instance only in the many-one proof.
alternative.derivation: SAT equals successful bounded stage OR residual failure; map successful instances to a fixed bad yes-instance, otherwise preserve input.
unresolved_steps: Prove nonemptiness or infinitude for k>=3 without assuming P!=NP.
candidate_tests: Exact stage success and residual witness counts; zero residual examples.
